text:
Priya: Heads up - eu-west rack-23 seeing steady ~15% higher tail latency on shared GPUs, started ~08:10 UTC.
ops-bot: ALERT: gpu.latency.p95 > 120ms in eu-west-1a (rack-23) - 12 nodes affected
Sam: noisy neighbor suspected. KV-cache churn spikes line up with tenant 'visionlab-prod' bursts.
Taylor: can we gate migrations instead of mass preempt? last time the fallback flooded warm pools.
Miho: suggestion: add a noise_threshold gate to allocator - only allow handoff if sustained >10m AND slab_churn > 0.2 to avoid flapping.
Jade: +1 to gating. also recommend a ratecap on node handoffs to avoid cascading drains (2 nodes / 5m per AZ).
Leo: quick commercial note - cascading drains push load to Dedicated which bumps costs for some customers. Ops visibility needed before aggressive evict.
Priya: Ops - what's the quickest safe config to reduce tail without breaking SLAs?
ops-bot: quick query snapshot: `curl -s "https://telemetry.internal/api/query?m=gpu.p95&rack=rack-23" | jq .` -> p95=128ms, p50=12ms, kv_churn=0.28
Sam: I'm running a dry-run drain with limits: `./drain-node --node node-23-11 --graceful --limit 2 --az eu-west-1a --dry-run`
Taylor: recommend canary order: low-priority batch -> internal dev -> prod. if p95 improves, continue slowly.
Miho: I'll land a small allocator patch: `noise_gate: {duration_s: 600, p95_thresh: 0.12, slab_churn_thresh: 0.2, ratecap_per_az: 2}`. staging test first.
Jade: deploying patch to staging now, will watch KV hitrate and p95 dashboards.
Priya: If p95 doesn't drop in 15m after canary, escalate and open a war room. ping me @here.
Sam: dry-run started, attaching logs here in 5m :eyes:
ops-bot: NOTE: scheduled maintenance window at 10:00 UTC - avoid wide-scale changes during window
Sam: quick log snippet: `evict_attempts=2, kv_throughput=1.6GB/s, p95=128ms -> 98ms after 1 canary node drained`
Taylor: nice - keep ratecap, iterate on duration if we see residual oscillation. :thumbsup:
Miho: will bump metrics alert sensitivity to avoid repeated flaps and add a cooldown metric for 30m after a gating action.
Jade: monitoring looks stable after canary, will promote to rollout-10% in eu-west-1 tomorrow morning during low traffic.
Priya: thanks team. we'll reconvene if anything shifts.
